label.purpose: Utility buttons, Discover heading, and clock.

action.purpose: Medium native face inside the painted hero action.

rail-label.purpose: All six hidden-overlay sidebar destinations in A, B, and C.

motion.name: remote-focus
motion.value: ViewPropertyAnimator: 140 ms, DecelerateInterpolator(), scale 1.025 for SHOW/APP/SPORT and 1.0 for HERO/COMPACT
motion.purpose: Finite remote focus scale, separate from the 180 ms spotlight/artwork transition. Disabled animators apply the final state immediately; hidden or detached cards cancel and settle.

motion.name: card-focus-spotlight-and-drift
motion.value: ValueAnimator.ofFloat: 180 ms, DecelerateInterpolator(), focus amount 0 to 1 controls spotlight opacity and up to 6 reference pixels of rightward artwork travel
motion.purpose: All PrettTvCard modes, including Library app cards. Focus loss returns to rest; interrupted changes retarget from the current amount. Starts only while attached, shown, and in a visible window. Window hiding, aggregated visibility loss, and detachment cancel both focus animators and settle current focus. Disabled animations apply final states immediately. No repeating or idle animation.

motion.name: horizontal-row-travel
motion.value: ValueAnimator.ofInt: 180 ms, DecelerateInterpolator(), native HorizontalScrollView scroll position
motion.purpose: Finite remote row travel; disabled animators use an immediate scroll. Unchanged rows retain focus, art, and viewport where possible.

native.implementation: Kotlin Android Views and Canvas; Theme.DeviceDefault.NoActionBar for native dialogs
native.units: DESIGN.md px values are 1920-wide design-reference pixels. Geometry scales by widthPixels / 1920f. Text additionally multiplies by resources.configuration.fontScale. They are not CSS pixels or Android dp.
native.fontAliases: Typeface.create(sans-serif or sans-serif-medium, Typeface.NORMAL); no numeric font weight or browser font stack is inferred.
native.previewPolicy: Native-only documentation. No HTML/CSS stand-ins, synthetic tonal ramps, browser previews, or inferred mobile breakpoints are supplied. The component entries describe the actual native primitives; the sidecar does not provide a runnable web rendering.

screenshots.provenance: docs/screenshots/A-cinema.png, B-quiet.png and C-balanced.png are unedited 1920x1080 ADB captures of v0.2.2 on the TCL TV, including the 208-wide Your apps tiles with 36-pixel corners and 12-pixel gaps. Scoped checks and outcomes are recorded in docs/validation.md.
screenshots.freshness: Feature dialogs, details, reminder states and the updater remain outside this Home visual review. Existing sidebar captures retain their separately recorded provenance.

gradients.purpose: Clipped ivory light inside every card. Focus amount controls paint opacity; text and HERO/SHOW scrims remain above it. No external glow or continuously running shader.

focus.cardCornerRadius: Your apps tiles use the approved 36-reference-pixel override for both clip and outline. Library tiles, sports-app shortcuts and other cards retain the 15-pixel default; compact imagery keeps its separate 10-pixel clip.
focus.compactRestOutline: None; the shared Discover panel supplies containment.
focus.heroActionOutline: 1.3 reference pixels with colors.hero-action-edge at rest; 2.5 with colors.ivory on focus.
focus.artworkDrift: Up to 6 reference pixels rightward at full focus. Landscape art reserves 12 pixels of horizontal overscan at rest; contained portraits cap drift to available side space. App logos keep their 70%-width/58%-height fit, fallback app artwork reserves 6 pixels per side, and sports logos keep their fit. Text, progress, and actions do not independently drift with the artwork.
focus.rail: Sidebar starts at View.GONE. Left from a first app reveals Library, other shelf starts reveal Shows, and the hero reveals Home. Open-rail buttons invert from colors.button-ground/colors.ivory to colors.button-focus/colors.sage-black. Left stays in the rail; vertical endpoints stop. Right or Back dismisses the overlay and restores content focus. Choosing a destination or returning focus to content also dismisses it.
focus.sidebarContentDimming: Content ScrollView alpha is 0.45 while the overlay rail is visible and 1.0 after dismissal. This is an immediate native visibility/alpha state change, not a new motion token.

native.reviewScope: Home geometry and card behavior follow the native implementation. Scoped checks, evidence versions and outcomes are recorded in docs/validation.md. Rendered previews document approvals; they are not native captures.

brand.placement: Footer About prettTV · Credits; no top wordmark or rail monogram.

native.userOverride: The owner approved final Your apps widths of 208 reference pixels with 36-pixel corners and 12-pixel gaps across A/B/C, plus the retained finite spotlight/drift. Heights remain 116/176/94. The corner override is only for Your apps: Library, sports-app shortcuts and content-card geometry stay unchanged. The hidden-by-default sidebar remains in every layout; Left at the first card reveals it and Right, Back, a destination or returning content focus dismisses it.
native.sourceDerivedStatus: Version 0.2.2 implements 208-wide Your apps cards with 36-pixel corners and 12-pixel gaps, retaining the finite spotlight and artwork drift. docs/validation.md records native checks and outcomes. Uncaptured feature dialogs and updater surfaces remain outside this Home visual review.
native.playbackEvidence: Published engagement timestamps seed a stored baseline and subsequent timestamp-only refreshes do not promote a title. Optional supported active media sessions or the manual I watched this most recently action update local recency. Notification access is required for the optional tracker; it does not read or store notification text. Missing or ambiguous title metadata remains unknown.
native.sportsHandoff: Optional accessibility assistance starts only after a selected game and is bounded to 30 seconds inside supported RBTV 3.0.320 layouts. It matches both teams and kickoff time for supported leagues, stops before server selection, and leaves unsupported or unmatched events to manual selection. No deep link, game availability, channel availability, or playback success is guaranteed.
native.packageMigration: The implementation workflow reports successful owner-preference export/import and removal of the previous application. Preference exports remain local and excluded from publication.

appIconPack.implementation: Twelve original PNGs plus a Disney+ Android vector adapted from the pinned SVG, all drawn on the shared dark ground.
appIconPack.initialFit: Contained within 72% of tile width and 68% of tile height before normal card logo fitting.
appIconPack.provenance: Homarr Dashboard Icons; pinned source URLs, SHA-256 hashes, and modification flags remain in sources.json. Preserve separate native Disney drawable attribution.
appIconPack.nativeDisneyDrawable: Disney+ uses ic_disney_dark composed on the native dark ground. HBO uses its attributed hbo-light asset for mapped packages. Unmapped apps retain installed artwork or label fallback.

native.publication: The owner requested a public GitHub repository when the work is finished. Selected A/B/C launcher captures may be published. Device dumps, account data, preference exports, and other-app screens remain excluded. This records the target, not a completed visibility check.
native.appVisibility: Hiding affects only the horizontal Your apps row. Library retains every discoverable app. TV proof: Prime Video hidden by Hold OK → Hide from Your apps row reduced the count 34 → 33; it remained in Library and offered Show in Your apps row; restoration returned 34. Search, suggestions, and viewing-history independence are source-verified rather than separate device-session results. Settings can clear all row-only hide choices.
native.helperValidation: PlaybackTracker and RBTV accessibility assistance are optional and remain off on the test TV. No end-to-end playback tracking, game matching, channel availability, or stream playback success is claimed.

appShelf.visibleFit: Eight complete Your apps tiles and a slice of the next in the 1808-reference-pixel content width when enough apps exist; finite row with every included app once.
appShelf.libraryGeometry: Unchanged six-column Library grid; integer (inner - 5 * 18) / 6 width, 154-reference-pixel height, 18-pixel gaps and 15-pixel corners. Shared APP focus treatment also applies to Library tiles.
appShelf.approvalHistory: docs/previews/premium-focus records the intermediate 208-width/15-radius/18-gap candidate and accepted motion. docs/previews/rounder-app-cards records v0.2.1's 208-width/22-radius/12-gap design. docs/previews/rounder-36 records the approved v0.2.2 36-pixel radius, retaining width 208 and gap 12. All contain rendered concepts; native checks are recorded separately in docs/validation.md.

rows.conditional: New episodes is omitted when there are no release alerts. Watchlist is present by default, including its native empty state.
rows.customization: Settings → Customize rows changes order, hidden state, card size, eligible title limits, and restores defaults. Saved preferences override default order.
rows.widthFormula: Integer (inner - count * 20 - 46) / count; preserves a visible next-card slice.
rows.titleLimits: Suggestions, Discover, Trending, and New releases accept 20, 40, or 60, default 60. Watchlist pages at 60 with newer/older saved-title actions.

personalContent.watchlist: Local saved titles, newest saved first, shared SHOW card language and Saved by you note. Empty state points to Hold OK → Add to Watchlist. Confirmed later local viewing may consume a saved entry with Undo; no availability promise.
personalContent.episodes: Follow/unfollow series through native menus. Verified release alerts produce the conditional New episodes shelf labeled Episode released · availability unconfirmed. Check status and dismiss actions are native; checks occur while Home is open.
personalContent.details: Scrollable native AlertDialog with synopsis, actual progress, source/availability text, Open / actions provider destinations, and Watchlist save/remove. Body uses the regular native face at 24 home-reference pixels. Uncaptured in current evidence.
personalContent.undo: Settings exposes the latest recorded action label. UndoHistory is bounded in-memory session history; it is not a guarantee for all operations or across restarts.
personalContent.feedback: Not interested affects recommendations and genre preference within service priorities, leaving saved titles and viewing history intact; Settings can reset feedback.

statusAndUpdates.sports: Favorite teams use native league and checkbox dialogs. Eligible kickoff reminders reuse a full-width tonal button below the header with Starting soon and OK to dismiss. No background/playback guarantee.
statusAndUpdates.offline: Muted support text in the Home header labels offline cached content and its age. Cached recommendation data expires after seven days.
statusAndUpdates.updater: Settings → Updates opens an explicit native screen with status, release notes, Check now, Download, Install, Cancel, and Back. It never opens automatically. Downloads need user action and installation needs Android confirmation.
statusAndUpdates.updaterNativeUnits: Source-local Android dp/sp: 52 dp button height, 8 dp corners, 1 dp card-edge outline, 17 sp button label, 12 dp gaps; disabled text 0xFF7C897E. Home reference-pixel tokens are unchanged.
statusAndUpdates.evidence: New dialogs, details, reminder states, and updater surfaces are source-derived and uncaptured in the current A/B/C set.

components.description: PrettTvCard.Mode.SHOW: existing imagery, dark metadata scrim, title, detail, and optional real progress. Standard remains the default; Small/Large row preferences reuse the same treatment. Watchlist and conditional New episodes reuse this component.

Left from a first card reveals it over dimmed content; Right, Back, or choosing a destination dismisses it. Library opens the complete Library · All apps grid.

narrative.overview:
The owner's direction is dark sage and black, lightweight and attractive, with subtle contrast and colored app logos. The interface feels restrained and cinematic: the dark ground recedes, real artwork supplies the color, and a small number of ivory focus treatments make the next remote action clear from a couch.

This is the native Android TV system: Kotlin Android Views, Canvas cards, native dialogs, and the device's system sans-serif aliases. C Balanced is the selected home; A Cinema and B Quiet remain available. The owner has chosen a left sidebar that is hidden by default in all three layouts and appears as a fixed overlay on request. The exact brand spelling is prettTV, appearing in the footer's About/Credits entry, with no top wordmark or rail monogram.

Implemented 0.2.2 Your apps geometry is 208 pixels wide with 36-pixel corners and 12-pixel gaps, retaining the finite spotlight/artwork drift and A/B/C heights. Library and other card geometry are unchanged. The sidebar contains Home, Shows, Library, Inputs, Search, and Settings. Left from the first card reveals it and dims content; Right, Back, or choosing a destination dismisses it. The Android application ID is `dev.zane.pretttv`. Rendered previews record design approvals; native checks and outcomes are recorded in docs/validation.md.
keyCharacteristics: Sage-black ground, gentle tonal separation, and fine visible card edges.
Actual provider artwork, attributed app icons, and installed-app marks supply the color.
A clear remote focus state, finite rows, and quiet finite motion.
A hidden-by-default left overlay sidebar shared by A, B, and C.
Native text scaling, readable metadata, and full accessible labels behind visual truncation.

rules.name: The Color-Pop Rule
rules.body: Keep the surrounding interface subdued so real app marks and still imagery carry the color.

rules.name: The Quiet Focus Rule
rules.body: Cards animate only when focus changes, then stay still. SHOW/APP/SPORT scale to 1.025 over 140 ms; HERO/COMPACT remain at 1.0. A separate 180 ms DecelerateInterpolator transition controls clipped spotlight opacity and up to 6 reference pixels of rightward artwork drift, returning on focus loss. Disabled animators apply final states immediately; hidden and detached cards cancel and settle.

dos: Do preserve the sage-black ground, fine visible card edges, and color-pop app marks.
Do keep remote focus clear through the implemented fill, outline, finite scale, clipped spotlight, and bounded artwork drift.
Do retain system font scaling, full accessible labels, and honest visual truncation.
Do use actual provider imagery, attributed icon assets, published progress, and labeled data sources.
Do order personal history using local playback evidence and distinguish discovery, game-assistance, and app-opening paths.
Do keep the six-destination sidebar hidden by default in all three layouts and make Library open the complete app grid.
Do spell the brand prettTV, keep branding and credits at the footer, and retain A and B as alternatives to selected C.
Do reuse native cards and dialogs for personal shelves, preserve user row preferences, and distinguish saved titles, release alerts, and playable availability.
donts: Don't add a top prettTV wordmark, top navigation, or rail monogram.
Don't replace native system sans with the obsolete automated Salsa guess, or flatten fictional comps into the running home.
Don't treat refreshed provider timestamps as proof of playback or invent progress, episode state, provider availability, or a verified sports stream link.
Don't turn finite app shelves into looping rows or repeat apps to imply more content.
Don't add idle animation, decorative drop shadows, or bright global accent surfaces to this quiet system.
Don't extend the confirmed hide/restore and Home checks into claims about untested playback tracking or RBTV matching.
Don't extend Home visual checks to uncaptured dialogs or apply one build's validation results to another build.
